app.name: KisanSetu
app.tagline: Check your crop, know today's price, and sell straight to buyers.
app.installHint: Add KisanSetu to your home screen from your browser menu.

landing.checkCropHint: Photograph a leaf to spot disease

onboarding.title: Add your first crop
onboarding.intro: We use this to send reminders and the right advice.

home.noCrops: No crops yet. Add one to get reminders and advice.
home.buyerIntro: Browsing listings arrives in the next build.
home.adminIntro: The admin console arrives in a later build.

errors.phone: Enter a 10-digit mobile number starting with 6, 7, 8 or 9
errors.phoneTaken: This number already has an account. Log in instead.
errors.network: Can't reach the server. Check your internet and try again.

diagnose.title: Check my crop
diagnose.whichCrop: Which crop is the leaf from?
diagnose.supportedNote: Right now we can check tomato, potato and maize.
diagnose.tip1: One leaf, filling most of the photo
diagnose.tip2: Plain background, like a cloth or your palm
diagnose.pickPhotoFirst: Take or choose a photo first
diagnose.photoFormat: Use a JPEG or PNG photo under 5 MB
diagnose.modelUnavailable: Crop checking is unavailable right now. Try again in a few minutes. Prices and selling still work.

result.uncertainBody: The photo could show one of these. Take a clearer photo of a single leaf, or check that you picked the right crop.
result.unsupportedBody: We can check tomato, potato and maize leaves for now. For other crops, ask your local Krishi Vigyan Kendra.
result.qualityTitle: This photo is hard to read
result.quality_blurry: It's blurry. Hold the phone steady and tap the leaf to focus.
result.quality_too_dark: It's too dark. Move into daylight.
result.quality_too_bright: It's too bright. Shade the leaf or step out of direct sun.
result.quality_other: Take the photo again in good light, with one leaf filling the frame.
result.errorBody: Something went wrong while checking. Try again with the same or a new photo.
result.disclaimer: This is an AI-assisted check, not a lab test. Before spraying anything, confirm with your local Krishi Vigyan Kendra or agriculture officer.
result.mockBanner: Test model: this result is a placeholder, not a real diagnosis.
result.modelThirdParty: Checked by an outside pretrained model ({version})
result.recheckAdded: We added a reminder to check this crop again in 7 days.

report.title: Your report
report.infoNeeded: This would help us be more sure
report.aiWritten: Written with AI help from the result above.
